subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain bounded media from unmentioned requireMention group messages for later mentioned turns, and what media-kind, TTL, local-path, and context-visibility limits must apply?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix changes how bystander group attachments can enter later model context, so automation should not choose the privacy and retention boundary.

options.title: Approve bounded local-image retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current authorization and context-visibility rules.

options.title: Keep unmentioned media skipped
options.body: Preserve today’s safer behavior where unmentioned Telegram group media is not downloaded or replayed, and document that only current or explicit reply media reaches the agent.

options.title: Require live design proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a proposed PR demonstrates the exact Telegram before/after flow with redacted live proof and explicit cleanup/path-leak safeguards.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded local-image retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current authorization and context-visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared history helpers and Telegram context policy, both areas with direct history from this owner signal.
